name: i-have-adhd
description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
readmeExcerpt:
ADHD-friendly outputs. No ADHD diagnosis needed!

🇬🇧 · 🇨🇳 · 🇧🇷 · 🇯🇵 · 🇻🇳 · 🇰🇷

## Install Copy/paste into your CLI prompt: ```text Install the i-have-adhd skill/plugin from https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd, refer to the repo's AGENTS.md for instructions. ``` Or 🔗 [check the installation instructions](INSTALL.md). ## What it does A skill for your coding assistant that stops it from burying the answer. Action first. Steps numbered. No "Hope this helps!" ## What changes
## Before > Great question! Let me think about this. Your auth flow has a few moving pieces: the middleware, the token verification, and the cookie handling. Looking at `src/auth.ts`, the `verifyToken` function (around lines 42-58) seems to be using an older `jsonwebtoken` API. One approach would be to update the package and rewrite that function. After making the change, you'd want to run the auth tests to confirm nothing breaks. By the way, you might also want to look at your dependency versions overall. Hope this helps! Let me know if you want to dig deeper. ## After > Run `npm install jsonwebtoken@latest`, then edit `src/auth.ts:42`. > > 1. Open `src/auth.ts` > 2. Replace `verifyToken` (lines 42–58) with the snippet below > 3. Run `npm test -- auth.spec.ts` > > Next: paste the first failing line if any test fails.
## The rules 10 rules. Full text in [SKILL.md](./skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md). 1. Lead with the next action. 2. Number multi-step tasks. 3. End with one concrete next step. 4. Suppress tangents. 5. Restate state every turn. 6. Specific time estimates (minutes, not "a bit"). 7. Make wins visible. 8. Matter-of-fact errors. 9. Cap lists at 5 items. 10. No preamble. No recap. No closers. ## Tune it Fork, edit `skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md`, then swap your copy in: ```bash claude plugin uninstall i-have-adhd # drop the upstream copy first: claude plugin marketplace remove i-have-adhd # fork and upstream share both names claude plugin marketplace add /i-have-adhd claude plugin install i-have-adhd@i-have-adhd ``` Restart Claude Code, then re-invoke `/i-have-adhd`. ## Cred

analysis.oneLine: i-have-adhd 是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，适合用于提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。
analysis.problem: AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束
analysis.audience: 使用 AI 编程的开发者、技术负责人、希望建立团队级 AI 编码规范的小团队
detailParagraphs: i-have-adhd 更准确地说是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，而不是一个只因为短期热度上榜的仓库。对国内用户来说，判断重点不应停留在 README 的自我描述，而要看它是否能解决一个真实、可复用、可持续维护的工作流问题：AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束。
如果把它放进实际使用场景，i-have-adhd 的价值主要来自提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。当前 Star 约 23,231，说明它已经具备一定社区关注度，但商业用户更需要继续验证三件事：是否能嵌入现有业务流程，是否能由团队基于 Python 技术栈持续维护，以及是否能形成稳定交付而不是一次性 Demo。
从商业化和私有化角度看，它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流。无需复杂部署，但需要根据团队技术栈、代码规范和安全要求改写后才能稳定使用。当前最需要警惕的是：风险在于规则泛化过度，直接复制可能不适合本地项目；需要结合真实仓库测试迭代。因此建议先用一个小范围真实任务做部署测试，再决定它适合作为内部工具、客户方案组件，还是仅作为趋势观察样本。
